Jitāmitra
writer on dh. Q. by Raghunandana (C. 1515-45) in Ekādaśītattva. (See Serampore edn. II. 25. JASB. (NS) XI (1915) p. 366); by Śrīdattopādhyāya in Samayapradīpa (see ibid. p. 380).
--C. Sāramañjarī on Rāghavapāṇḍavīya. Hpr. III. 247.

Jitāyurgarbhitastavana

Jitāri
poet. Skm. p. 301 (Lahore edn.); verse no. 2170 (Calcutta edn.). See Jitāripāda below.
Q. in a.. C. Candrālaṅkāra on Candravyākaraṇa. See Int. Cong-Ori. VII. (1888). Vol. 1, p. 125.

Jitāri
teacher of Durveka (a. of Dharmottarapradīpa) an. of Dīpaṅkara.
See colophon of Dharmottarapradīpa, Patna edn. p.. 149 an. 257.

Jitārinandin,_ºnandana
Subhāṣitaratnakośa 12 (S. 122.). Buddhist poet. prob. same a. the Tāntric writer from Bengal, Jitāri or Jetāri. C.. Guhyajetāri (NCC. VI. p. 90b) an. poet Jitāri above.
See next.

Jitāripāda
poet. Subhāṣitaratnakośa 28. Buddhist logician from Varendrī, son of Garbhapāda (Brahmin priest or courtier of King Sanātana of Bengal (Tārānātha Geschichte p.. 230 ff) under the Pālas); made paṇḍita of Vikramaśilā monastery by King Mahā(ī)pāla, with a special residence. C. A. D. 940-80.
--Jātinirākaraṇa ny. discovered in Nepal an. published by Tucci, ABORI. XI. (1930).

Jitendra_Bhaṭṭa
--Mātṛkāśakuna. Mithilā III. 259.

Jitendriya
11th Cent. writer on dh.; of Bengal. Q. by Jīmūtavāhana (C. 1100 A. D.) in Kālaviveka (Bib. Ind. edn. p. 380); Dāyabhāga an. Vyavahāramātṛkā; by Raghunandana in Dāyatattva; by Śūlapāṇi an. by Trimalla in Smṛtiratnāvalī.
See Ind. Cult. II. p.. 276-77; JASB. (NS) XI (1915) p.. 315. 317. 319 an. R. C. Majumdar, His.. of Bengal Vol. I. p. 319. [Page249-a.

Jitendriyastotra

Jītakalpa(sūtra)
or Jīyakappa(sutta). Jain. in 103 Pkt. Gāthās; 6th Chedasūtra. by Jinabhadra Gaṇi Kṣamāśramaṇa. See Kapadia, Canonical Lit. of the Jainas p.. 147-8.
BORI. 75 (a. of 1880-81. 1153 of 1887-91 (with C.). 573 of 1895-98 (with C.). BORI. D. XVII. ii. 591. 592 (with C.). 593 (with C.). D. p. 172. Jainagranthāvalī p. 54. Kh. 75 (a.. Pannalal Bombay V. B. p.. 19. 20 (Pt..). Peters. I. App. p. 70 (no. 101. with C.).
Pt.. (1) in Roman script with extracts from C. of Siddhasena. Sitzungsberichte der Berliner Ak. der Wissenschaften 1892, 1195-1210. (2) with C. of Siddhasena an. C.. by Candrasūri. Jaina Sāhitya Sam3śodhaka Gr. mālā 7. Ahmedabad, 1926.
--C. Bhāṣya in Pkt. (3125 ślokas). Jainagranthāvalī p. 54. Jesalmere p. 15. Skt. Intro. p. 24.
--C. Bṛhaccūrṇivyākhyā or Viṣamapadavyākhyā. composed in Sam3. 1227 by Śrīcandrasūri, pupil of Dhaneśvara. Jainagranthāvalī p. 54. Pattan I. p. 399. Peters. V. Extr. p. 128. Intro. p. lxxiv.
For a ms. copied in Sam3. 1284 in Seth Halabhai collection see ABORI. III. p. 36.
--C. Vivaraṇalava in Skt. by Śrītilakasūri, pupil of Śivaprabhasūri. BORI. 1153 of 1887-91. BORI. D. XVII. ii. 592. Jainagranthāvalī p. 54. BP. [Page282-a. p.. 228a. 250b. JASB. 1908, p. 416b (no. 7394). Peters. V. Extr. p.. 130-31. Pattan I. p. 292.
--C. Bṛhaccūrṇi in Pkt. an. Skt. 1300 granthas. by Siddhasena. BORI. 23 an. 24 of 1880-81. 1233 of 1887-91. BORI. D. XVII. ii. 594-96. D. p. 166. Jainagranthāvalī p. 54. Kh. 23. 24. Pattan I. p.. 398-99. Ref. to by Śrīcandrasūri in his C.
